title: ReminderRecoveryBatchResponse
description: Persisted idempotent recovery batch for the fixed 72-hour window, inclusive 5-minute ring grace rule, and global 20-detail limit. The legacy field name window_overflow_count is retained for storage compatibility and counts every in-window Reminder placed in the summary.
x-recovery-count-invariants: window_start_at equals started_at minus 72 hours; the ring grace boundary is derived as started_at minus 5 minutes and is not persisted separately.
A ring Reminder with remind_at exactly equal to started_at minus 5 minutes remains detail-eligible; one earlier by any positive duration is forced to summary.
detail_reminder_ids and summary_reminder_ids are disjoint and contain every selected in-window Reminder exactly once.
window_overflow_count equals summary_reminder_ids.length and includes both ring Reminders outside the five-minute grace window and otherwise eligible Reminders excluded by the global 20-detail limit.

older_skipped_reminder_count.description: Count of reminder instances strictly before window_start_at, including unmaterialized recurring instances and materialized open Reminders atomically changed to expired.

window_overflow_count.description: Compatibility name for the total number of in-window Reminders assigned to summary, whether due to ring grace expiry or the 20-detail limit. Must equal summary_reminder_ids.length.
